error_chain.expected_solution: Cross-repo propagation chain: (1) Spring's TransactionTemplate wraps the operation in a JTA-style transaction via JpaTransactionManager which delegates flush decisions to the EntityManager -> (2) Hibernate's SessionImpl owns the dirty-entity action queue; an HQL query triggers DefaultAutoFlushEventListener which flushes pending actions before the query runs -> (3) A native SQL query path bypasses DefaultAutoFlushEventListener because Hibernate cannot determine which entities the SQL touches; FlushMode.AUTO does not apply to native queries -> (4) The native query reads the database directly, sees the pre-save value, and Hibernate's first-level cache still holds the new value; the transaction commits with the discrepancy invisible until downstream code re-reads.
